zone_no_postcode.title: Zone center has no known postcode
zone_no_postcode.description: The center of {zone} (search “{search}”) is not near a known postcode. Move the zone center or add a postcode to the search. The last known postcode is still used.

zone_missing.title: Zone not found
zone_missing.description: The zone {zone} used by search “{search}” no longer exists or has no coordinates. Restore the zone or choose another zone in the search options. The last known postcode is still used.
